exposure: bladder filling with saline before percreta surgery
Bladder filling with saline before percreta surgery
cohort: 88 patients diagnosed with placenta accreta who underwent cesarean hysterectomy between January 1, 2009 and January 1, 2019
finding: Filling the bladder with saline before cesarean hysterectomy for placenta accreta was associated with a lower rate of bladder injuries and shorter surgery duration.
mod_finding: Filling the bladder with saline before cesarean hysterectomy for placenta accreta was associated with a lower rate of bladder injury.
